programme.title: 14 Phere
programme.desc: Sanjay, a Rajput, is in love with Aditi, a Jat, and wants to get married. However, they realise that their parents would never allow it, so they come up with a cunning plan to get married.

programme.title: Nazar
programme.desc: After encountering an accident, Divya, a singer, is given the gift of being able to see the future. She decides to use her ability to help Inspector Rohan in finding a serial killer.

programme.title: Turtle
programme.desc: Ramkaran tirelessly churns the dry earth of a village in Rajasthan for water. Meanwhile, the villagers participate in desperate measures to satisfy their thirst.

programme.title: The Last Color
programme.desc: Choti, a young tightrope walker, wishes to pursue her education but struggles to make a living. She soon befriends Noor, a widow who yearns to play Holi but is forced to live a life of abstinence.

programme.title: Sam Bahadur
programme.desc: Sam Manekshaw, an Indian army officer, navigates through his eventful life filled with ups and downs, including him getting promoted to the rank of Field Marshal.

programme.title: Sheetla Mata
programme.desc: A widow tells her sons about her dream in which Goddess Sheetala advises her to construct a temple. The sons try to fulfil her wish but face strong opposition from the zamindar.

programme.title: Dil Aashna Hai
programme.desc: Laila, a cabaret dancer who grew up in a brothel, gets a call from her dying mother divulging that she was adopted. So, she takes the help of her lover, Karan, in finding out who her real parents are.

programme.title: Vaishnavi
programme.desc: Born with the divine power, Vaishnavi receives treatment as a goddess by the villagers. After getting killed, she possesses the body of another girl who looks like her to exact revenge for her death.

programme.title: Run
programme.desc: Jhanvi and Siddharth fall in love with each other. However, things take a dangerous turn when Ganpat, her brother, does not favour their relationship and plans to kill Siddharth.

programme.title: Jodi No. 1
programme.desc: This is Film - Drama Category

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: In order to settle scores with a police commissioner, a gangster hires a hitman, Jackie to abduct his daughter, Radha. But Jackie ends up falling in love with her and undergoes a transformation.

programme.title: Hijack
programme.desc: A maintenance engineer lays his life on the line to save his daughter and other passengers on a plane hijacked by terrorists. He uses the help of an air-hostess in an effort to foil their plan.

programme.title: Footfairy
programme.desc: A CBI officer investigates a string of gruesome murders committed by a serial killer with a foot fetish. However, things take an ugly turn when he gets close to catching the killer.

programme.title: Khamoshiyan
programme.desc: Kabir, a struggling writer, journeys to Kashmir seeking inspiration and takes lodging in a mysterious guesthouse. He finds himself falling for Meera, the enigmatic owner, who harbours a dark secret.

programme.title: Vadh
programme.desc: Burdened by debt and harassed by a loan shark, a retired school teacher's life takes a drastic turn when he acts on his impulses, leading to murder.

programme.title: Saaya

programme.title: Aai Aai Ya Karoon Mai Kya
programme.desc: Bringing the best in cinema.

programme.title: Prem Granth
programme.desc: Somen, a rich man, falls in love with Kajri, a village belle. However, they get separated when she suddenly leaves for unknown reasons.

programme.title: Commando 3
programme.desc: Commando Karan Singh Dogra and Inspector Bhavna Reddy race against time to thwart a terrorist attack on India. Later, they realise that foiling mastermind Buraq's plan is harder than it seems.
